dcat_keyword_sm: Osoyoos Division of Yale Land District
dct_creator_sm: Jemmett, William Sugden (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Westbank Nation reserves Tsinstikeptum 9, Tsinstikeptum 10 and Mission Creek 8 around Okanagan Lake and Kelowna. Land cover and features described on the map includes fields, farms, springs, Tenas Lake, trails, huts, Mission church, and the types of land, soil, and timber.
